findings.message: The case authenticates as warehouse_operator, while the requirement permits approval only for sales_manager; the successful approval oracle is therefore unsupported for this role and the behavior for warehouse_operator must be specified.
evidence: REQ-AUTH-001.text=Only sales_manager may approve an order through POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/approve; a successful approval returns HTTP 200 with status APPROVED.
TC-AUTH-001.steps[0].expected_result=HTTP 200 is returned with status APPROVED.
TC-AUTH-001.expected_outcome=HTTP 200 is returned with status APPROVED.
